name: _placeholders.scss
html:
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
//  _placeholders.scss — @extend-only blocks shared across stylesheets:
//  %RESETBTN (button reset), %MAXAREA (max-width content column + responsive
//  gutters — the site's main layout constraint), and the skeleton surface.
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

// Reset buttons

/// Bare-button reset — removes UA chrome (background, border, outline,
/// padding) plus the iOS tap highlight; extended by every icon-only or
/// custom-styled control.
%RESETBTN {
  background-color: transparent;
  border: none;
  outline: none;
  padding: 0;
  user-select: none;

  -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent;
}

/// The site's main layout constraint — full-width content column whose
/// horizontal padding IS the grid gutter per breakpoint. Iterates
/// $grid-steps via the `grid-steps` mixin so the content gutters and the
/// show-grid debug overlay always read the same table.
%MAXAREA {
  width: 100%;
  position: relative;
  box-sizing: border-box;
  // Gutter = the step's $gap — ($un-$step − $grid-max-area-$step) / 2
  // resolves to exactly the gap token, so padding IS the gutter.
  padding: 0 to-rem($gap-272) 0;

  // One media query per $grid-steps entry — the overlay reads the same map
  // via `grid-steps`, so content gutters and the debug grid never drift.
  @include grid-steps() using ($step, $gap, $cols) {
    padding: 0 to-rem($gap) 0;
  }
}

.max-area {
  position: relative;
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
}

// Skeleton placeholders on dark surfaces: lift the local dark tone toward
// white instead of mixing the global light surface. The resolved --skel-bg-*
// custom properties are declared here (not derived from --skel-surface)
// because color-mix() inside a custom property is evaluated where the
// property is declared — descendants would otherwise inherit :root values.

/// Dark-surface skeleton palette — redefines --skel-bg-*/--skel-ink as
/// color-mix() lifts of --bg-dark toward white. The vars are redeclared
/// (not derived from --skel-surface) because color-mix() inside a custom
/// property resolves at the declaration site — descendants would
/// otherwise inherit the :root light-surface values.
%SKEL_DARK_SURFACE {
  --skel-bg-1: color-mix(in srgb, var(--bg-dark) 90%, var(--color-white-raw) 10%);
  --skel-bg-2: color-mix(in srgb, var(--bg-dark) 78%, var(--color-white-raw) 22%);
  --skel-bg-3: var(--skel-bg-1);
  --skel-ink: var(--color-white-raw);
}

// ═══ Inline text-link underline — drawn at rest, sweeps in on hover ═══
// The underline draws ONLY on hover/focus: the resting border-bottom is
// transparent so nav/footer rows stay clean, and border-color is one of
// the few properties :visited is allowed to restyle (pseudo-elements and
// backgrounds always paint as :link). On hover/focus the transparent
// border hands off to a ::after hairline at the exact same offset,
// growing left to right once via transform — no looping animation, so
// the first hover no longer blinks. In-content prose links that need a
// resting underline (draw-text, in-depth pages) carry their own rule.
// Block-level links (stacked footer rows) should add `width: fit-content`
// so the line hugs the text instead of spanning the column.
%LK_LINK {
  position: relative;
  border-bottom: to-rem($space-hairline) solid transparent;
  transition: border-bottom-color 0.3s ease;
  cursor: pointer;

  &::after {
    content: '';
    position: absolute;
    inset-inline: 0;
    bottom: calc(-1 * to-rem($space-hairline));
    height: to-rem($space-hairline);
    background: currentColor;
    transform: scaleX(0);
    transform-origin: left center;
    transition: transform 0.35s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1);
    pointer-events: none;
  }

  &:visited {
    border-bottom-color: transparent;
  }

  &:hover,
  &:focus-visible {
    &::after {
      transform: scaleX(1);
    }
  }

  @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
    &:hover,
    &:focus-visible {
      border-bottom-color: currentColor;

      &::after {
        transform: scaleX(0);
      }
    }
  }
}

// ═══ Type-ramp placeholders — the .ttl-*/.txt-* class bodies ═══
// _fonts.scss re-emits them as the real utility classes for document
// markup; component/partial sheets @extend the % versions so a shadow
// stylesheet carries ONLY the type rules it actually uses instead of
// importing the whole ~200-line ramp.

/// Shared title font — every .ttl-* level.
%TTL_BASE {
  font-family: var(--font-primary);
}

%TTL_XXL {
  font-weight: 100;
  font-size: to-rem(34);
  letter-spacing: to-rem(5);

  @include layout-768() {
    font-size: to-rem(55);
    letter-spacing: to-rem(13);
  }

  @include layout-1024() {
    font-size: to-rem(55);
    letter-spacing: to-rem(13);
  }

  @include layout-1680() {
    font-size: to-rem(89);
    letter-spacing: to-rem(21);
  }

  @include layout-2560() {
    font-size: to-rem(144);
    letter-spacing: to-rem(55);
  }

  @include layout-3840() {
    font-size: to-rem(233);
  }
}

%TTL_XL {
  font-weight: 100;
  font-size: to-rem(34);
  letter-spacing: to-rem(5);

  @include layout-768() {
    font-size: to-rem(34);
    letter-spacing: to-rem(8);
  }

  @include layout-1024() {
    font-size: to-rem(55);
    letter-spacing: to-rem(13);
  }

  @include layout-2560() {
    font-size: to-rem(89);
    letter-spacing: to-rem(21);
  }
}

%TTL_LG {
  font-weight: 200;
  font-size: to-rem(18);

  @include layout-768() {
    font-size: to-rem(21);
  }

  @include layout-1024() {
    font-size: to-rem(34);
  }

  @include layout-1440() {
    font-size: to-rem(55);
  }

  @include layout-1560() {
    font-size: to-rem(55);
  }
}

%TTL_MD {
  font-weight: 200;
  font-size: to-rem(21);
  letter-spacing: to-rem(8);

  @include layout-768() {
    font-size: to-rem(34);
  }
}

%TTL_SM {
  font-weight: 200;
  letter-spacing: to-rem(2);
  font-size: to-rem(13);

  @include layout-768() {
    font-size: to-rem(21);
    letter-spacing: to-rem(3);
  }

  @include layout-2560() {
    font-size: to-rem(34);
    letter-spacing: to-rem(5);
  }
}

%TTL_XS {
  font-weight: 200;
  font-size: to-rem(13);

  @include layout-2560() {
    font-size: to-rem(21);
  }
}

%TTL_XXS {
  font-weight: 200;
  font-size: to-rem(13);
  text-transform: uppercase;

  @include layout-2560() {
    font-size: to-rem(13);
  }
}

%TTL_SPECIAL {
  font-weight: 100;
}

/// Shared body-text font — every .txt-* level.
%TXT_BASE {
  font-family: var(--font-primary);
}

%TXT_LG {
  font-weight: 100;
  font-size: to-rem(21);

  @include layout-1024() {
    font-size: to-rem(34);
  }
}

%TXT_MD {
  font-weight: 100;
  font-size: to-rem(13);
  line-height: to-rem(21);

  @include layout-1680() {
    font-size: to-rem(21);
    line-height: to-rem(34);
  }

  @include layout-2560() {
    font-size: to-rem(34);
    line-height: to-rem(55);
  }
}

%TXT_SM {
  font-weight: 100;
  font-size: to-rem(13);
  line-height: to-rem(21);

  @include layout-2560() {
    font-size: to-rem(21);
    line-height: to-rem(34);
  }
}

%TXT_XS {
  font-weight: 100;
  font-size: to-rem(8);
  line-height: to-rem(13);

  @include layout-2560() {
    font-size: to-rem(13);
    line-height: to-rem(21);
  }
}
